sinopsis.es: Ignacio es un joven cineasta que quiere hacer una película, sin embargo, al encontrarse sin trabajo, su extravagante madre le propone realizar distintas tareas en la boutique familiar, ubicada en el balneario Reñaca.
sinopsis.en: Ignacio is a young filmmaker who wants to make a film. Finding himself unemployed, his extravagant mother proposes that he take on various tasks at the family boutique, located in the beach resort of Reñaca.
